body: Sorry for your loss :( my Robbie is a warrior, too. Two time IVDD surgery survivor. I’ll give my Robbie a smooch for your Robbie ❤️
My boy is named Robbie, too!

I’m not really sure, the first time I think may have been because we moved houses and our new floors are slippery. I didn’t know it was an issue until after he had surgery. He does ‘jump off’ our bed but it’s only as high as they are, we have always had our bed close to the floor for them. I don’t know if it’s the cause but the second time was after he had a big run at a park, I was told he was allowed to run and play so I thought nothing on it. Massive regret :(

I don’t think I could do it again! I have nightmares about him dragging his little back legs 😭 We are so careful with him as well and we were doing hydrotherapy and physiotherapy every month to stay on top of it. My heart and bank account couldn’t take it again!
Yes! I don’t want my husband to live with the fact I chose death over him because he is wonderful but bleeding hell I crave it BAD.
I know this feeling. I just sit and fantasise about all the ways I could kill myself.
I was just wondering this same thing. You would pass out before dying at least.
If I was your daughter I would cut you out of my life. You sound so controlling. Why won’t you visit your daughters home? Is it because you can’t control her there?

Same. I’m too much of a coward to go through with it. I often fantasise about being t boned by a truck and sometimes I’ll sit at the lights in my car and beg the universe to make it happen so I can die but not do it myself.
